instruction: For my job search, I've drafted emails to all potential employers in the last 3 days. Attach cv.pdf from my file system to each of them. If it's already attached, update it as I just made some changes to it. Then send the emails.
notes: Two apps (gmail, file_system) plus supervisor. The reference count of 12 API calls implies 3 employer drafts, modeled as draft-1..3 with the static fact (employer-draft ?d); gmail.show_drafts (min_created_at = now - 3 days) makes (drafts-listed) true, after which drafts can be used. cv.pdf's path is discovered via file_system.show_directory with substring 'cv.pdf' and recursive=true, asserting (known-path cv-pdf-path). gmail.upload_attachments_to_draft is always called with overwrite=true so that drafts that already have cv.pdf attached get the updated file; attachment_file_paths is the one-element list [cv-pdf-path]. gmail.send_email_from_draft requires the resume to be attached and deletes the draft (modeled by (sent ?d), which blocks further uploads). supervisor.complete_task takes the three distinct drafts as non-API record parameters so its precondition structurally equals the goal (all attached and sent); it is called with no answer. The agent should filter listed drafts to those addressed to potential employers (same job-application subject).
